name: resistance band kneeling sissy squat
description: A kneeling sissy squat with a resistance band for assistance or load. It places a big stretch on the quads.
instructions: Set the band at a stable anchor and kneel with it around your body or hands.
Keep your hips forward and your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Lean back slowly, keeping your hips extended.
Go as far as you can control.
Use your quads to pull yourself back up.
Keep your core braced and your movement smooth.
